title: Total mass of the uniform law on one bit
statement: The uniform law on a single bit, viewed as a measure on the two-element set of Boolean values, assigns real-valued mass $1$ to the whole space; that is, the measure of the universal set equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: none — bare identity for the uniform law on one bit
replaced: The uniform law on \texttt{Bool} has total mass $1$.
